area: Several Dubai branches, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Bluewaters; What's On also mentions JBR Beach and Kite Beach
name: Angel Cakes
questions: Which items contain oats or oat flour, and which contain quinoa?
Is every item gluten-free, or are a few not?
quinoa_oat_flags: Health cafés like this often serve granola, porridge or oat-based cakes. Ask about oats and quinoa in breakfast bowls and cake bases.

safe_dishes.note: Named by What's On in January 2026. The café is dedicated to GF and refined-sugar-free food.
Harper's Bazaar Arabia describes GF breakfasts. Reviewers say staff ask carefully about allergies.

summary: The best-verified dedicated gluten-free café and cake option. It was still operating and delivering via Careem and Deliveroo as of January 2026.
